bio.text: Software engineer building backend and applied AI systems, from enterprise integrations and retrieval agents to a solo-built B2B SaaS platform. Work spans discovery, implementation, deployment, and production operations.

bullets.text: Owned product and engineering as the first hire and sole engineer, taking a B2B SaaS platform from zero to production in four months with 40 REST endpoints, PostgreSQL, and designer, admin, and client access tiers.
Embedded with early design-studio customers to scope shifting requirements, then built role-based access and real-time SSE portals around each tier’s workflows.
Cut new e-commerce integration time from two days to under 15 minutes by replacing per-site scrapers with a Claude and Puppeteer pipeline that turns product URLs into structured data.
Chose Stripe subscription billing over usage metering after mapping the pricing model, then shipped checkout, webhooks, and entitlement checks end to end.
Ran the stack on one 1GB OCI VM, offloading builds to GitHub Actions and using health-gated cutover with automatic rollback for zero-downtime deployment; owned incidents through customer follow-up.
Raised semantic retrieval accuracy 36 percent by replacing fixed-size chunking with heading-scoped parent and child chunks across documents above 20 MB.
Chose Qwen3 8B embeddings for retrieval quality over serving cost, pairing a reranker with citation-grounded generation so answers trace to source chunks.
Built a multi-agent orchestration system for field sales across Salesforce, HubSpot, OneDrive, and internal databases on Azure, serving 75,000 daily users and 1.5 million requests over six months.
Scoped the first release by shadowing field sales representatives and prioritizing their three most common queries.
Cut contract and document lookup from about 15 minutes to under 30 seconds with an agent backend over Salesforce, HubSpot, OneDrive, and internal SQL.
Raised retrieval accuracy from 61% to 89% with chunk-level indexing, reranking, and a vector cache in front of the RAG layer.
Cut per-query inference cost 45% by fine-tuning a smaller model with QLoRA and PEFT and routing simple intents away from the larger model.
Moved authorization inside the agent loop with Graph API tenant isolation and RBAC per request, restricting retrieval to contracts the requesting persona could access.

Replaced blanket LLM screening with keyword and prompt-injection matching, spaCy relevance scoring, and a Llama judge for low-confidence inputs; added intent classification, tool-planning guardrails, and scope checks before external tool calls.
Added cross-encoder reranking as the corpus grew from 10,000 to 300,000 documents, tracking context relevance, recall, precision, and MRR to catch retrieval regressions.
Hardened tool calls with exponential backoff, capped retries, a dead-letter queue, and per-node fallbacks, tracing runs in LangSmith to investigate divergent plans.
Cut manual data-handling overhead 70% by integrating OAuth 2.0 with HubSpot and Salesforce for contract and record lookups.
Cut release time from a manual half-day to a 12-minute GitHub Actions pipeline by containerizing services and deploying on Azure through customer review and approval.
Delivered conversational-AI systems for 24+ enterprise clients including IHCL, Dr. Reddy’s, Bajaj Finserv, and Spotify, scoping use cases with customer teams.
Unblocked launches through on-site CRM, ticketing, and data integrations at IHCL, Dr. Reddy’s, and Bajaj Finserv, driving InfoSec approvals on both sides.
Held 99.9% uptime on the messaging backbone as the product received 100M+ daily events across all customers, owning consumer services and retry paths on a six-engineer platform team.
Cut p95 API response time from 820ms to 490ms by rewriting MySQL and MongoDB query plans, adding composite indexes, and caching hot reads in Redis.
Onboarded 50+ enterprise CRM integrations without latency regression through a shared connector interface reused per client.
Cut pipeline maintenance roughly in half by migrating legacy rule-based intent handling to LLM-backed classification across 20+ enterprise bot workflows.
Carried on-call for the messaging tier, adding consumer-lag alerting and runbooks to reduce repeat incidents.
Ran client standups, demos, and onboarding through go-live, feeding recurring integration gaps into the Studio roadmap as reusable connectors.
Fine-tuned BERT and open-source LLMs with LoRA for intent classification and named entity recognition, lifting chatbot accuracy 60% and CSAT 35%.
Started migrating rule-based conversation backends to LLM-driven agents in late 2022, implementing input/output filtering and tenant-isolated permission checks.

Replaced uniform Kafka campaign rate limits with region-tiered limits keyed to customer ARR, user base, and timezone across India and US clusters; isolated high-ARR enterprise traffic on dedicated partitions and lower-priority events on shared ones.
Cut harmful and off-topic responses 28% before production through RLHF-aligned preference datasets and reward-model checkpoints.
Architected event-driven agentic microservices in Node.js and Kafka to route multi-turn conversations and resolve tool calls.

experience.role: Program Trainee Analyst, Full Stack Developer

bullets.text: Cut order-lookup response time from 1.2s to 700ms by decomposing a legacy Java monolith into Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs, holding automated test coverage above 80%.
Improved team velocity 30% during the migration.
Paired with senior engineers through review and release to land changes in an existing production codebase.
Built an autonomous job-sourcing agent with a 13-node graph workflow discovering postings under 24 hours old across six ATS platforms, then deduplicating and ranking them freshness-first.
Enforced tool safety with a guarded_url_arg decorator that checks a hard-coded allowlist before execution, blocking login pages, apply forms, and shorteners.
Built a custom nodriver WebSocket debug-protocol client after Playwright and Puppeteer stealth variants failed against CDP-layer bot detection, with 55 tests and Langfuse tracing.

Combined ATS APIs, search, funding-event discovery, company watchlists, and public LinkedIn posts in a discovery and extraction workflow, with exact and semantic duplicate checks before SQLite persistence.
Surfaced results through a FastAPI/Jinja2 review dashboard with freshness buckets and a recent-postings filter.
Cut turnaround on a one-hour meeting from 45–75 minutes to 7–11 minutes with a queue-based asynchronous worker backend.
Kept FastAPI focused on accepting jobs and reporting status, with Redis holding queues, job state, and results.
Decoupled Splitter, Transcriber, and Summarizer workers over Redis queues with Whisper and Gemini; used idempotent retries so workers scale horizontally without API or state-layer changes.
Built a Flask cricket simulation platform with a modular REST API and a 13-model SQLAlchemy schema using indexed queries and cascade deletes, running live on OCI.
Served 13,000 active users and resolved a 120-delivery match in under five seconds.
Kept concurrent match state correct using per-match threading locks and a single-worker, multi-thread Gunicorn deployment.
Built a probabilistic ball-outcome engine over WebSockets, incorporating phase, momentum with 0.88 exponential decay, and pressure, with 80%+ coverage across a six-configuration CI matrix.
Engineered a seven-layer game-state momentum engine and a 13-dimensional state vector.
Owned architecture, session authentication, Nginx, zero-downtime deployment, and production incident response as the sole engineer.
Extended crimera/piko’s recommended-flags system from boolean-only to long-typed MobileConfig overrides, hooking long-returning bytecode accessors and carrying the change through maintainer review.
Built a job-matching pipeline that polls changed ATS data, filters postings by role, freshness, location, and eligibility, then routes each candidate to one of four résumé tracks for LLM scoring.
Persisted scoring outcomes and failures in SQLite, with CSV audit exports, a local dashboard, and scheduled email digests guarded against repeat sends after restarts.
Supported local Ollama scoring and configurable hosted providers, with per-provider retries and a daily spending limit.
Built a self-hosted job-search dashboard around the vendored jobhive / ats-scrapers library, combining scheduled ingestion with job filtering, application tracking, company blocklists, and analytics.
Used SQLite WAL mode and FTS5 full-text search, with synchronization triggers, application history, and per-run scrape audit records.
Served JSON APIs and an interactive dashboard using FastAPI, Jinja2, and HTMX.
Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that captures job descriptions and sends résumé profiles to a FastAPI backend for tailoring.
Integrated Google Gemini for keyword extraction and tailored résumé content, with matched/missing keyword feedback and a heuristic compatibility score.
Generated PDF and editable DOCX documents using Jinja2 templates, WeasyPrint, and python-docx.
Prepared CodeAlpaca-20k instruction, input, and response examples as JSONL for coding-model fine-tuning.
Implemented a Gemma fine-tuning notebook using 4-bit loading and PEFT LoRA adapters targeting query and value projections, with gradient accumulation and saved model artifacts.
Built a Python command-line pipeline that validates structured YAML résumé data, normalizes it to JSON, and tailors content against a job description through the Perplexity API.
Generated LaTeX from tailored content and orchestrated PDF/DOCX conversion, collecting output artifacts into a named directory.
Built a Flask application and prediction API for six emotion classes: sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, and surprise.
Preprocessed text with NLTK and TF-IDF, returning predictions from Logistic Regression, SVM, and a Keras MLP for comparison.
